messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Do not take tramadol if you are:
are allergic to tramadol, to any of the other ingredients in your product, or to other opioids
have significant breathing problems (respiratory depression)
have acute or severe asthma and are somewhere you cannot be monitored, or where resuscitation equipment is not available
have a known or suspected blockage of the stomach or intestines, including paralytic ileus
have taken a monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) in the past 14 days (such as isocarboxazid, linezolid, methylene blue injection, phenelzine, or tranylcypromine)
are younger than 12 years of age
are younger than 18 years of age and have recently had surgery to remove your tonsils or adenoids.
Seizures have occurred in some people taking tramadol.
Your seizure risk may be higher if you have ever had:
a head injury, epilepsy, or other seizure disorder
drug or alcohol addiction or
a metabolic disorder.
To make sure tramadol is safe for you, tell your doctor if you have a history of:
Head injury or seizures
Problems urinating
Liver, kidney, or thyroid problems
Triplet: ["tramadol", "requires patient history of", "kidney problems"]

The relation 'requires patient history of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug requires the patient to inform their healthcare provider about the medical condition or history specified by the object entity before use.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'should inform doctor about': Patients taking the subject drug should tell their doctor about the condition or circumstance specified by the object entity.
B. 'related to': The subject drug is associated with the medical condition or disease specified by the object entity.
C. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
D. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
